subject: maths
question:
The givengraph shows the higher secondary result of a particular school, from 2019 to 2021. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f8691f8f3f5dbd4c28adc5312b9766858dd2d9de9ecbfa5ec948bd93e9fcf4.png] 

The ratio of the number of students who passed with first division in all the 3 years to the total number of students in 2020 is:
solution:
First Division students:

2019: 20 students

2020: 70 students

2021: 85 students

Total number of students in 2020 (from the graph):

First Division: 70 students

Second Division: 80 students

Third Division: 95 students

Failed: 5 students

Total number of students in 2020 = 70 + 80 + 95 + 5 = 250 students

Total First Division students in 2019, 2020, and 2021 = 20 + 70 + 85 = 175 students

⇒ Ratio = 175 / 250

⇒ Ratio = 7/10

**∴ The ratio of the number of students who passed with first division in all three years to the total number of students in 2020 is 7 : 10.**
